findings.label: Dead code in ClaimDecisionEngine
findings.description: The ClaimTooLow guard at line 67 (targetClaimAmount < existingListingCurrentClaim) is unreachable. The AllTimeCumulativeTooLow guard immediately above it uses <= and already returns for all inputs where target < existing. Remove guard B or narrow guard A to < and consolidate into a single error code.

findings.label: CurrentClaimAmount silent no-op in Today mode
findings.description: PlaceClaimCommandHandler skips the CurrentClaimAmount update when IsAllTimeMode == false and the new target does not exceed the listing's all-time high. A Claim row is written (daily payment recorded) but the rank score is unchanged. A user paying $80 against a $150 all-time listing gets no rank movement despite being charged. This needs an explicit decision: if intentional, document it and add a dedicated column; if not, it is a silent data-loss bug.

findings.label: Missing test for Today-mode payment below all-time high
findings.description: No test covers PlaceClaimCommandHandler with IsAllTimeMode = false and targetClaimAmount < existingListing.CurrentClaimAmount — the exact path where the silent no-op from finding #2 fires. Add an integration or handler-level unit test that asserts the Claim row is written and clarifies the expected CurrentClaimAmount outcome.
